title: The Boy Who Learned Tech: A Coding Adventure Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12
subtitle: Fun and Easy Tech-Themed Coloring Pages with Computers, Robots, and Coding Fun
description: Join a young boy on his exciting journey through the world of technology! This coloring book features 10 bold, easy-to-color pages designed specifically for kids ages 6-12. From discovering computers to meeting friendly robots, your child will explore the amazing world of tech while having fun with crayons and markers. Each page features thick clean outlines, simple designs, and adorable characters that make learning about technology an adventure. Perfect for future coders, tech enthusiasts, and any kid who loves to create!
cover_prompt: Full-color vibrant children's book cover illustration. A cheerful young boy with big excited eyes sitting at a colorful desk with a glowing computer monitor. Friendly cartoon robot standing beside him giving a thumbs up. Floating tech icons around them: code brackets, wifi symbols, gears, lightbulbs. Bright primary colors - blues, oranges, greens. Professional children's book cover art style, eye-catching and fun. White background. Coloring Book for Kids Ages 6-12.
